maksim-burtsev-punchcard-punchcard.description: Architecture-level design review of a code change: module boundaries, dependency direction, data model, error paths, cost of the next change — never naming, formatting, or anything a linter catches. Use when the user invokes /punchcard, says 'punchcard review', or asks for any design, architecture, or structural review of a diff, branch, merge request, or PR. Do not use for general correctness/bug review, style feedback, or whole-repo audits.
